layers.rule: Continuous base; use large calm areas and avoid repeated visible motifs.
Worn and cultivated variants are alternate full ground tiles; replace the base tile for those cells rather than stacking a full diamond on top.
Path is a transparent ribbon overlay with broken grass/soil edges. Worn ground uses a full alternate tile with irregular mixed edges; never place an opaque full diamond over another tile.
Place the road under moving animals/vehicles and worn-ground variant in high-traffic cells under their ground-contact anchors; house stone pad and tree roots provide their own grounding.

placementRules.depth: render ground layers first, then objects sorted by ground-contact anchor
placementRules.scale: all tile surfaces share 2:1 projection and logical footprint [2,2]
placementRules.repetition: alternate base and state tiles deterministically; do not repeat one pattern in a visible grid
placementRules.approval: all entries remain REVIEW until visual, alpha, color-profile, and 3x3 transition review pass
